basis.title: Period of Insurance
basis.text: Cover operates only for loss or damage occurring between 00:00 hours on the policy start date and midnight on the policy end date shown in the Schedule. Loss occurring outside the period of insurance is not covered.

basis.title: Premium Payment Condition
basis.text: No liability attaches under this policy unless the premium has been paid in full and realised. If the premium cheque or mandate is dishonoured, the policy is void from inception.

basis.title: Insured Vehicle
basis.text: Cover applies only to the vehicle whose registration number, engine number and chassis number are stated in the Schedule. Loss to any other vehicle is not covered under Section I.

basis.title: Section I — Natural Calamities
basis.text: Loss or damage caused by flood, inundation, storm, cyclone, hurricane, hailstorm, earthquake or landslide is covered. Claims under this clause are verified against meteorological records for the location and date of loss.

basis.title: Exclusion — Consequential Engine Damage from Water
basis.text: Damage to the engine caused by ingress of water (hydrostatic lock) resulting from the vehicle being driven or cranked in water-logged conditions is not covered, unless the Engine Protect add-on is opted.
basis.note: Engine components ₹2,85,000 excluded — Engine Protect not opted

basis.title: Add-on — Zero Depreciation
basis.text: Where Zero Depreciation is opted and shown in the Schedule, depreciation under M-3.2 is not deducted for up to two claims in the policy year.
basis.note: Zero Depreciation add-on — no depreciation deducted

basis.title: Compulsory Deductible
basis.text: Each and every claim under Section I is subject to a compulsory deductible of INR 1,000 for vehicles up to 1500cc and INR 2,000 above 1500cc, in addition to any voluntary deductible stated in the Schedule.

basis.title: Total Loss and Constructive Total Loss
basis.text: Where the cost of repair exceeds 75% of the IDV, the vehicle is treated as a Constructive Total Loss and the claim is settled on a total-loss basis at IDV less salvage, subject to the deductible.
basis.note: Repair cost ₹6,85,000 exceeds 75% of IDV ₹6,75,000 — total-loss basis
